# 1 Enoch Chapter 92 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Ge'ez MS; cf. 4QEn (Aramaic) | **Section:** Epistle of Enoch

---

**1** This is the book of Enoch the scribe — a complete body of wisdom and instruction, honored by all people, a judgment on the whole world. Written for my children who will live on the earth, and for the final generations who will choose to live righteously and in peace.

**2** Don't let your heart be disturbed by the times. The Holy and Great One has set his calendar — every season has its appointed day.

**3** The righteous will wake from sleep. They will rise and walk the paths of righteousness, and everything about their lives — every path, every step — will be bathed in lasting goodness and grace.

**4** God will show the righteous his kindness, giving them eternal integrity. He will grant them power, clothing them in goodness and right living. They will walk in eternal light.

**5** Sin will die in the darkness — gone forever, never to appear again from that day on.

---

*PNEUMA notes: This five-verse chapter is the opening declaration of the Epistle. Enoch's self-identification as scribe situates him not just as prophet but as heaven's record-keeper. The contrast of eternal light (v. 4) against the darkness that swallows sin (v. 5) is a powerful framing device for the fierce chapters ahead.*
